sharing.dialog.title: Share “{name}”
sharing.expiry.hintPlain: The administrators set how long at most.
sharing.org.rangeRelative: {range}, relative: whoever opens it sees this range from then.
sharing.org.valuesText: {values}. They can be changed afterwards as always.
sharing.org.panelText: Opens a single panel instead of the whole dashboard.
sharing.org.note: Sign-in needed. Whoever opens the link signs in and sees the dashboard with their own rights. The link gives nobody more rights.
sharing.block.server: Public sharing is off on this server. Server admins turn it on under Administration > Sharing. Links and snapshots in the organization keep working.
sharing.block.org: Public sharing is off in this organization. Organization admins change that under Administration > Sharing in the organization. Existing links are suspended while it is off.
sharing.block.off: Public sharing is off, on the server or in this organization. Ask an admin. Links and snapshots in the organization keep working.
sharing.block.permission: Sharing in public needs the permission dashboards:public. Admins and owners of the organization have it.
sharing.public.lead: Anyone with the link sees this dashboard without signing in. The stored queries of the panels run with your rights, for as long as you have them. Query text and data sources stay hidden.
sharing.public.maxWindowHint: Visitors pick a range within the last {window}.
sharing.public.valuesHint: Visitors see these values and cannot change them.
sharing.public.canText: pick the range within the window and refresh
sharing.public.cannotText: change variables, switch to Explore, see queries
sharing.public.once: The address is shown only now. Kalzit does not keep it readable; if it gets lost, create a new link.
sharing.public.others: More public links on this dashboard
sharing.snapshot.name: Name
sharing.snapshot.whoText: In the organization: every member who may read “{name}”. Public: anyone with the link.
sharing.snapshot.note: A snapshot stores results, not queries. The values stay as they are now, in their shape (frame, documents, graph). Opening it asks no data source.
sharing.snapshot.needsShare: Snapshots in the organization need the permission dashboards:share.
sharing.snapshot.frozenNote: Snapshot of {date}, {scope}. The values are frozen; it expires on {expires}. Everyone who may read “{dashboard}” may see it.
sharing.snapshot.frozenNoteBy: Snapshot of {date} by {name}, {scope}. The values are frozen; it expires on {expires}. Everyone who may read “{dashboard}” may see it.
sharing.snapshot.goneText: It has expired or was revoked. The dashboard shows the current values.
sharing.expiry.title: Change expiry
sharing.expiry.label: Expires on
sharing.expiry.hint: Until {date} at the latest. The administrators allow {duration} from today.
sharing.expiry.past: The day must lie in the future.
sharing.revoke.title: Revoke “{name}”?
sharing.revoke.textLink: The link stops working at once. Whoever opens it sees “This link is not available.” This cannot be undone; a new link can be created at any time.
sharing.revoke.textSnapshot: The snapshot cannot be opened from now on, and its stored results are deleted. This cannot be undone.
sharing.suspended.creatorRemoved: The person is no longer in the organization.
sharing.suspended.creatorRights: The person lacks rights on the dashboard or its sources.
sharing.suspended.dashboardTrashed: The dashboard is in the trash.
sharing.list.creator: Created by
sharing.list.kept: Expired and revoked ones stay visible for 30 days.
sharing.list.name: Share and dashboard
sharing.list.footnote: The person who created a share and organization admins may revoke it. Every creation and revocation is in the audit log; views are only counted, without data about visitors.
sharing.empty.title: Nothing shared yet
sharing.empty.text: Public links and snapshots are made on a dashboard with “Share”. They then appear here, with expiry and views.
sharing.mine.emptyText: Open a dashboard and choose “Share”. For colleagues the link in the organization is enough.
sharing.mine.tip: Tip: for people without an account a snapshot is often the calmer choice: it shows exactly the state of now and asks no source.
sharing.mine.suspendedOne: 1 share is suspended. “{name}” shows visitors “This link is not available.” {reason} Once the reason is gone it works again, unless it has expired.
sharing.mine.suspended: {count} shares are suspended, “{name}” among them. Visitors see “This link is not available.” {reason} Once the reason is gone they work again, unless they have expired.
sharing.mine.footnote: Signed in as {name}. Revoking and changing the expiry also work while a link is suspended.
sharing.viewer.unavailableText: If the data should stay visible to you, ask the person who sent the link.
sharing.viewer.live: Data is queried on opening and refreshing.
sharing.viewer.frozen: Stored results, no queries. Does not change any more.
sharing.viewer.clamped: The range was limited to the last {window}.
sharing.viewer.shortenedNote: The range was shortened to lie within the shared window.
sharing.viewer.earliest: {date} at the earliest. The last {window} are shared.
sharing.viewer.panelUnavailable: This panel cannot be loaded right now.
sharing.viewer.notInSnapshot: Not in the snapshot. This panel was left out when it was created.
sharing.reason.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
sharing.reason.public_off: Public sharing is off, on the server or in this organization.
sharing.reason.sources_forbidden: Some data sources of this dashboard are closed to your queries. A public link would run with your rights, so it cannot be made.
sharing.reason.expiry_invalid: The expiry must lie in the future, at most {maxDays} days from today.
sharing.reason.window_invalid: The time window does not fit the longest expiry.
sharing.reason.range_invalid: A public link needs a relative range to open with, such as “Last 24 hours”.
sharing.reason.window_exceeded: The range lies outside the shared window.
sharing.reason.snapshot_too_large: The snapshot would be larger than allowed ({max}). Choose a shorter range or ask the administrators for a higher limit.
sharing.reason.snapshot_rate_limited: You made {max} snapshots within a minute. Wait a moment before the next one.
sharing.reason.too_many_snapshots: This organization already keeps {max} snapshots, as many as allowed. Revoke the ones nobody needs any more, then try again.
sharing.reason.snapshot_storage_full: The snapshots of this organization would take more space than allowed ({max}). Revoke the ones nobody needs any more, then try again.
sharing.reason.busy: Shared dashboards are busy right now. Try again in a moment.
